## Stub — needs /dso:brainstorm before implementation

Follow-on stub descoped from 4911-c7ba (bug-classification registry).

## Context

Code-reviewer agent rubrics (plugins/dso/skills/shared/docs/reviewers/ and code-reviewer prompt files) currently contain hardcoded bug-class references (e.g., 'check for hermeticity', 'verify cross-runner equivalence'). Once plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.md (delivered by 4911-c7ba) is the single source of truth for bug-class names, reviewer rubrics may drift from the registry — same concept, divergent names. This stub captures the work to audit reviewer prose and align with registry slugs or record justified divergence.

## Proposed Success Criteria (sketch)

- Audit script scans reviewer SKILL.md and prompt files for bug-class-like terminology.
- Each finding maps to a registry slug, or carries a justified-divergence note.
- Audit integrates with the existing bug-classification registry audit test (same gate, additional assertion).

## Out of scope

- Modifying the registry itself.
- Authoring new reviewer rubrics.

## Status

Stub — scrutiny:pending. Run /dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id> before /dso:preplanning.
data.title: Code-reviewer agent rubric alignment with bug-classification registry
